description: Hand-labeled ground-truth evaluation dataset for customer email triage

cases.email: Hi, I was billed $49 yesterday but my contracted plan is $29/month. Please refund the $20 difference immediately.
cases.expected_summary: Customer disputes an overcharge of $20 and requests a refund.

cases.email: Can someone email me the VAT invoice for order #INV-98234? Our accounting team needs it for quarterly tax filing.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests a VAT invoice for order #INV-98234 for tax filing.

cases.email: My company credit card expired. Where in the billing dashboard can I update the expiration date and CVC?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks how to update payment card details in the billing dashboard.

cases.email: We want to upgrade from the Starter Tier to the Enterprise Tier for 45 seats. Could you provide a quote?
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests an enterprise pricing quote to upgrade 45 seats.
cases.notes: Upgrade inquiry involving sales and billing

cases.email: You charged my card twice for the annual renewal on Nov 3rd. Please cancel the duplicate transaction.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was double-charged for an annual subscription and asks to cancel the duplicate charge.

cases.email: I cancelled my subscription three weeks ago within the 30-day money-back window but haven't received my money back.
cases.expected_summary: Customer follows up on a missing refund for a cancelled subscription.

cases.email: Please downgrade our plan back to Basic starting next billing cycle. We don't need Pro features anymore.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests a plan downgrade to Basic effective next billing cycle.

cases.email: Why is there an unexplained $15 surcharge listed as 'Cloud Processing Fee' on our October statement?
cases.expected_summary: Customer inquires about an unexpected $15 processing surcharge on their statement.

cases.email: Do you offer non-profit or educational discounts for 501(c)(3) organizations?
cases.expected_summary: Customer inquires about non-profit or educational pricing discounts.

cases.email: Our bank blocked the auto-debit because our corporate fraud alert triggered. Can you re-run the transaction now that we cleared it?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks to retry a failed auto-debit transaction after clearing a bank fraud alert.

cases.email: Can you change our billing cycle from monthly to annual to take advantage of the 20% discount?
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests switching from a monthly to an annual billing cycle.

cases.email: Need W-9 form from your company before our procurement department can issue payment.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests a W-9 form for vendor onboarding and payment processing.

cases.email: The webhook endpoint is returning HTTP 500 status codes on every POST payload since 14:00 UTC.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports that webhook endpoints are throwing HTTP 500 errors on all POST requests.

cases.email: Whenever we attempt to export CSV files with more than 10,000 rows, the browser tab freezes and crashes.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports browser crashes when exporting CSV datasets larger than 10,000 rows.

cases.email: Our production database integration keeps throwing 'ConnectionPoolTimeoutException: timeout waiting for idle connection'.
cases.expected_summary: Customer encounters a database connection pool timeout exception in production.

cases.email: great, ANOTHER outage. love paying for this rock-solid 99.9% uptime.
cases.expected_summary: Customer sarcastically complains about an ongoing service outage.
cases.notes: Sarcastic tone; could be misinterpreted as general complaint or billing

cases.email: API response latency has spiked from 120ms to over 3500ms in the us-east-1 region this morning.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports a severe API latency spike in the us-east-1 region.

cases.email: Your Python SDK version 2.4.1 throws an AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'stream_events'.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports an AttributeError in Python SDK v2.4.1.

cases.email: The mobile app crashes immediately on launch on iOS 18.1. Here is the stack trace attached.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports immediate app crash on iOS 18.1 with attached stack trace.

cases.email: Websocket connection drops every 60 seconds with close code 1006. Is there a heartbeat ping required?
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports abnormal websocket disconnections with code 1006 and asks about heartbeat configuration.

cases.email: The search indexing job has been stuck on 'Processing (98%)' for over 18 hours.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports a background search indexing job stuck at 98% progress.

cases.email: SSO SAML assertions are failing with error 'AudienceRestriction mismatch'. We use Okta as our IdP.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports Okta SAML SSO assertion failures due to an audience restriction mismatch.
cases.notes: Intersection of authentication and technical protocol error

cases.email: PDF rendering is missing Japanese and Korean Unicode characters, showing empty boxes instead.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports CJK font rendering failure resulting in placeholder boxes in generated PDFs.

cases.email: I forgot my password and the reset link emailed to me says 'Token expired or invalid'. Please send a fresh one.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot reset their password because the reset token expired and requests a new link.

cases.email: My phone was stolen so I cannot get my Google Authenticator 2FA code. How do I recover my account?
cases.expected_summary: Customer lost their 2FA device and needs account recovery assistance.

cases.email: Please transfer the Workspace Owner role from alice@company.com (who left the company) to bob@company.com.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests transferring workspace ownership from a departed employee to a new administrator.

cases.email: Under GDPR Article 17, I request complete deletion of my account and all associated personal data.
cases.expected_summary: Customer submits a GDPR Right to Erasure request for account and personal data deletion.

cases.email: How do I invite external contractor members with Read-Only permissions so they cannot edit production dashboards?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks how to invite contractors with restricted read-only permissions.

cases.email: I need to change the primary login email address from john.doe@oldfirm.com to john@newfirm.com.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests updating their primary account login email address.

cases.email: Someone in Russia attempted to log into my account according to the security alert. Please lock it down.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports a suspicious unauthorized login attempt and requests security lockdown.

cases.email: Our team SSO enforces Google Workspace login, but one external auditor needs email+password access.
cases.expected_summary: Customer inquires about bypassing SSO enforcement for an external auditor.

cases.email: Why is my account showing as 'Suspended for Terms of Service review'? We haven't violated anything.
cases.expected_summary: Customer appeals an unexpected account suspension for terms of service review.

cases.email: Can we merge two separate team accounts into one unified organization without losing our historical dashboards?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks if two team accounts can be merged while preserving dashboard history.

cases.email: Where are your European data centers physically located? Our compliance department requires confirmation of Frankfurt hosting.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks for verification of European data center locations for compliance purposes.

cases.email: Do you have an affiliate or referral partner program for digital marketing agencies?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks about agency affiliate or partnership program opportunities.

cases.email: We love your product! Would your CEO or Head of AI be interested in being a keynote speaker at PyCon next spring?
cases.expected_summary: Customer invites company leadership to give a keynote presentation at PyCon.

cases.email: Are you hiring senior distributed systems engineers in North America? Where should I send my CV?
cases.expected_summary: Customer inquires about engineering job openings and recruiting contacts.

cases.email: Could you provide your latest SOC2 Type II certification and ISO 27001 summary report under NDA?
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 security compliance documentation under NDA.

cases.email: Is there a roadmap for supporting dark mode on the mobile web interface?
cases.expected_summary: Customer inquires about public roadmap plans for mobile web dark mode.

cases.email: What are your standard support operating hours and phone contact numbers for emergency SLA incidents?
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests support operating hours and emergency contact details.

cases.email: help
cases.expected_summary: Customer sends a single-word message asking for help without context.
cases.notes: Extremely short email with no domain context

cases.email: URGENT PLEASE CALL ME BACK 555-0192 MY SYSTEM BROKE DOWN
cases.expected_summary: Customer urgently requests a phone callback regarding a broken system.
cases.notes: All-caps high-urgency crash without technical details

cases.email: Bonjour, je n'arrive pas à télécharger ma facture de septembre. Le bouton est inactif.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports being unable to download their September invoice in French.
cases.notes: Non-English (French) invoice download issue; could be mistaken for technical bug

cases.email: Hola, olvidé mi contraseña y no recibo el correo de recuperación. Ayuda por favor.
cases.expected_summary: Customer states in Spanish that they forgot their password and are not receiving recovery emails.

cases.email: I am unable to login because my billing card failed and your system blocked my profile access.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is locked out of their account due to a failed payment card.
cases.notes: Ambiguous multi-intent: login lockout caused directly by billing failure

cases.email: plz hlp!! cannt login pwrd wrng thx
cases.expected_summary: Customer struggles to log in due to an incorrect password with heavy typos.

cases.email: I want to cancel everything and get a full refund because the app crashes every time I load my projects.
cases.expected_summary: Customer demands cancellation and a full refund due to frequent application crashes.
cases.notes: Crash mentioned, but actionable core resolution sought is cancellation and refund

cases.email: Amazing release notes! Just wondering if the new webhook signature validation supports SHA-256 HMAC?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks if webhook signature validation supports SHA-256 HMAC.
cases.notes: Compliment leading into technical API question

cases.email: Can you change our billing email to invoice@acme.corp without altering the primary admin account?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks to configure a separate dedicated invoice notification email.
cases.notes: Billing contact setting vs account profile

cases.email: Our server cron job failed with '429 Too Many Requests'. What are the exact rate limits for our tier?
cases.expected_summary: Customer inquires about rate limit thresholds after receiving HTTP 429 errors in a cron job.

cases.email: Who is the data privacy officer (DPO) for your organization?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks for the identity or contact info of the company Data Privacy Officer.

cases.email: Why did my monthly subscription charge increase by $10 without any advance email notification?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks why their monthly fee increased by $10 without prior notice.

cases.email: The search bar returns zero results whenever an apostrophe is entered in the query string.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports that search queries containing apostrophes return no results.

cases.email: Can we enable mandatory two-factor authentication across all 150 members of our enterprise organization?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks how to enforce company-wide 2FA across all organization members.

cases.email: Your documentation page on rate limits links to a 404 page.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports a broken 404 link on the rate limiting documentation page.
cases.notes: Broken doc link; could be viewed as technical or general documentation feedback
